notes.title: 09/22 Update Complete Announcement
notes.content: [p]Hello, Commanders![/p][p]Thank you for your patience. The update for Star Lusts is now complete![/p][p][/p][p]♥ Update Details ♥[/p][p][/p][p]1. New Characters[/p][p]  ★SSR Hilda, the Blade's Bride[/p][p]  ★SSR Annee Winter, the Unbridled White[/p][p][/p][p]2. \[2nd Anniversary Celebration] Consumption Event[/p][p]- Availability: 2025/09/22 (post maintenance)～2025/10/20 03:59 (UTC+8)[/p][p]- Consumption Points can be collected between 2025/09/19 04:00 and 2025/10/20 03:59 (UTC+8).[/p][p]- Claim Availability: After sending～2025/11/19 03:59 (UTC+8)[/p][p]- Consumption Points are obtained when using platform currency to purchase items in the Store and Bundle pages. A reward will be granted after reaching a certain number of Consumption Points.[/p][p]- Rewards are sent directly to a player's in-game Mail inbox. Each reward granted from reaching a certain number of Consumption Points can only be claimed once.[/p][p][/p][p]Event rewards[/p][p]- 50 Consumption Points : Gear Summon Ticket x5[/p][p]- 300 Consumption Points : Star Fragment x2[/p][p]- 700 Consumption Points : Gear Summon Ticket x5[/p][p]- 1100 Consumption Points : Select Basic Unleash Material Box x5[/p][p]- 2000 Consumption Points : General Summon Ticket x10[/p][p]- 3000 Consumption Points : Random SSR Drone x1[/p][p]- 5000 Consumption Points : Advanced Pulse Host x10[/p][p]- 7000 Consumption Points : 〈Consumption Point〉Random SSR Character x1[/p][p]- 10000 Consumption Points : Mega Pulse Host x5[/p][p]- 14500 Consumption Points : 〈Consumption Point〉SSR Exclusive weapon Select Ticket x1[/p][p]- 18500 Consumption Points : 〈Consumption Point〉SSR Character Select Ticket x1[/p][p][/p][p]※ Select Basic Unleash Material Box: Select and obtain Basic Cadette Unleash Material Box (Iron Screw x25, Standard Oil x25, Basic Power Ball x10) or Basic Courtesan Unleash Material Box (Xenosect Eggs x25, Rare Embryo x25, Universe Seeds x10).[/p][p]※〈Consumption Point〉Random SSR Character: Randomly obtain Character Fragments ×50 of one of the following characters:Hilda, the Blade's Bride, Annee Winter, the Unbridled White, Sea Angel Mimic - Mi , Una, the Megalodon , Mia, the Light Saintess , Astraea, the Jade Amazon , Connie, the Blue Heart Protector , Pyra, the White Sand Priestess , RinRinka Okita, the Bat , Hanarin, Starfish Symbiote.[/p][p]※〈Consumption Point〉SSR Exclusive weapon Select Ticket: Select and obtain one of the following Exclusive Weapons:Lone Veil Bouquet; Loveheart Bear Hug; Invernal Angel;  Rift Devourer; Purelight Aria; Emerald Glimmer; Blue Heart Alert; Wave Dance: Sakura Rain β; Virgin Reaper; Moisty Taboo Grimoire.[/p][p]※〈Consumption Point〉SSR Character Select Ticket: Select and obtain one of the following characters' Character Fragment x50: Hilda, the Blade's Bride, Annee Winter, the Unbridled White, Sea Angel Mimic - Mi , Una, the Megalodon , Mia, the Light Saintess , Astraea, the Jade Amazon , Connie, the Blue Heart Protector , Pyra, the White Sand Priestess , RinRinka Okita, the Bat , Hanarin, Starfish Symbiote.[/p][p][/p][p]3. Crystal Shop First-purchase Offers Reset[/p][p]- Availability: 2025/09/22 (post maintenance)[/p][p]- After the update, all items at the Crystal Shop will reset to double-discount on the first purchase.[/p][p][/p][p]4. \[Sweet Encounter Bundle][/p][p]- Availability: 2025/09/22 (post maintenance)～(indefinitely)[/p][p]- Unlock conditions: "Routine" unlocks (requires clearing Main Story Chapter 1) and completing Encounter Event "Mia — Encounter Story 02".[/p][p]※ Can be purchased within 7 days after unlocking.[/p][p]Sweet Encounter Bundle α[/p][p]- Purchase Limit: Once[/p][p]- Contents: Encounter Points x2, Stamina x40[/p][p]Sweet Encounter Bundle β[/p][p]- Purchase Limit: Once[/p][p]- Contents: Encounter Points x4, Stamina x80, Free Crystals x200[/p][p]Sweet Encounter Bundle γ[/p][p]- Purchase Limit: Once[/p][p]- Contents: Encounter Points x12, Stamina x180, Free Crystals x800[/p][p]※ Purchasing any of the Sweet Encounter α, β, or γ bundles will make the "Sweet Encounter Bundle" unavailable.[/p][p]Sweet Encounter Bundle[/p][p]- Purchase Limit: Once[/p][p]- Contents: Encounter Points x18, Stamina x300, Free Crystals x1,000[/p][p]※A one-time purchase of the Sweet Encounter α, β, and γ bundles (the Sweet Encounter α, β, and γ bundles are no longer available after this purchase).[/p][p][/p][p]5. \[2nd Anniversary Celebration] Limited Missions[/p][p]- Availability: 2025/09/22 (post maintenance)～2025/10/20 03:59 (UTC+8)[/p][p]- Enter through "2nd Anniversary Celebration" on the upper-left corner of the main screen[/p][p]- There's a chance to obtain Character Fragments, Exclusive Weapon, Birthday Encounter Key and abundant rewards[/p][p][/p][p]6. New \[2nd Anniversary Celebration] Encounter events are available[/p][p]- "Two-year Anniversary 01" Availability: 2025/09/22 (post maintenance)～2025/10/20 03:59 (UTC+8)[/p][p]- "Two-year Anniversary 02" Availability: 2025/10/06 14:00～2025/11/03 03:59 (UTC+8)[/p][p]- During the event time, players can unlock the "Two-year Anniversary" Encounter events.[/p][p]※ Once unlocked, the encounter event will be permanently available.[/p][p][/p][p]7. \[2nd Anniversary Celebration] Log in to get 10 Summon Tickets[/p][p]- Availability: 2025/09/22 (post maintenance)～2025/10/20 03:59 (UTC+8)[/p][p]- Day 1: (Event Limited)  Summon Ticket ×10[/p][p]- Day 2: (Event Limited) Gear Summon Ticket ×10[/p][p]※ "(Event Limited)  Summon Ticket" Can only be used for the "Flower of the Oath—A Lonely Soul" event-limited Summon.  When both event-limited summon tickets and general summon tickets are held, the event-limited summon ticket will be used first.[/p][p]※ "(Event Limited) Gear Summon Ticket" Can only be used for the "Flower of the Oath—A Lonely Soul" event-limited Exclusive Weapon Summon. When both event-limited summon tickets and general gear summon tickets are held, the event-limited summon ticket will be used first. Completing all 5 stages of missions will grant you the final reward![/p][p]- Character Level-Up Missions: During the event, leveling up the limited SSR characters to specified levels will reward you with a significant amount of gold and EXP chips, aiding in the rapid growth of your characters![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]11. \[Flower of the Oath—A Lonely Soul] Event Mileage[/p][p]- Availability: 2025/09/22 (post maintenance)～2025/10/20 03:59 (UTC+8)[/p][p]- You can access the "Event Mileage" through the entrance on the upper-left corner of the main screen.[/p][p]- Complete Mileage missions to obtain Mileage Points.[/p][p]- Collect Mileage Points and claim rewards once reaching a specific amount.[/p][p]- There's a chance to obtain exclusive drone "Leviathan EX" and portrait "Doggo Dusty", "Doggo Sooty".[/p][p]- Use Crystals to immediately unlock Mileage Phases.[/p][p]- Activate the "Flower of the Oath Mileage Certificate" to receive 1000% Super Value Offer additional rewards.[/p][p][/p][p]12. \[Flower of the Oath—A Lonely Soul] Log-In Rewards[/p][p]- Availability: 2025/09/23 04:00～2025/10/13 03:59 (UTC+8)[/p][p]- Happy 2nd Anniversary! Bonus login rewards for a limited time![/p][p]- There's a chance to obtain Exclusive Portrait "White Cub Bridegroom",as well as significant amount of Free Crystals, Gold and other rewards.[/p][p][/p][p]13. \[Flower of the Oath—A Lonely Soul] Event Collection Area[/p][p]- Availability: 2025/09/22 (post maintenance)～2025/10/14 03:59 (UTC+8)[/p][p]- Enter through "Collection Area - Exclusive Collection" of the main screen[/p][p]- Obtain even more Vow Token, Event Tokens and Pulse Host![/p][p][/p][p]14. notes.title: ★ User Interface and FAQ ★
notes.content: [p]Hello, Commanders![/p][p]Star Lusts, the brand-new shoot 'em up game is now officially available![/p][p]All extraterrestrial babes are awaiting your command~ Brilliant battles, exciting events, and rich rewards await you![/p][p]With the following interface explainer and FAQ, we wish all Commanders a smooth journey across the universe with their lovely ladies![/p][p][/p][h2]♥ User Interface ♥[/h2][p]This game currently supports the following functions.[/p][p][/p][h3]▼ Joystick and Keyboard Functions[/h3][p][b]Keyboard:[/b][/p][p]- In combat: Switch characters (Z,X)[/p][p]- In combat: Use character skill (Spacebar)[/p][p][/p][p]Future updates are expected to support the following functions:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Keyboard:[/b][/p][p]- In combat: Control character movement (W,A,S,D or arrow keys)[/p][p]- In combat: Pause/Continue combat (ESC)[/p][p][/p][p][b]Joy Stick:[/b][/p][p]- In combat: Character movement (left joystick)[/p][p]- In combat: Switch characters (LB,RB)[/p][p]- In combat: Use character skill (Y)[/p][p]- In combat: Pause/Continue combat (Start)[/p][p]- General game interface: Move virtual cursor (left joystick)[/p][p]- General game interface: Confirm (A)[/p][p][/p][h2]♥ FAQ ♥[/h2][p][/p][h3]1. What is a UID?[/h3][p]Your UID is your account ID.[/p][p]Tap on the player avatar in the top left corner of the game interface to open player info, where you can copy your UID or access saved screenshots.[/p][p]Your UID can be used to verify and restore your account. We recommend keeping a note or taking a screenshot of your UID.[/p][p][/p][h3]2. Where can I change my language settings?[/h3][p]Tap on the gear icon in the top right corner of the game interface to open the Settings screen, then scroll down to find and access language options.[/p][p][/p][h3]3. What time does each in-game day reset?[/h3][p]Each in-game day resets at 20:00 (UTC).[/p][p][/p][h3]4. How do I redeem codes?[/h3][p]Tap on the gear icon in the bottom right corner of the game interface to open the Settings screen. Under the Other Settings option, select "Redeem Code" to input the code.[/p][p][/p][h3]5. Where do I claim my purchased Monthly Pass content?[/h3][p]With the Crystal Monthly Pass, receive specific items and enjoy exclusive Monthly Pass privileges for 30 days. Rewards will simply be sent directly to your player account when logging in, so no claim procedure necessary![/p][p]Please remember to log in during the purchase period to receive your items.[/p][p][/p][p]Happy adventures through the universe, Commander![/p][p]Star Lusts Team[/p]
